evaluation_type: retrieval + verification + paired inference on real embeddings

rules.gallery: pid >= 0 in bounding_box_test/ — official test gallery: distractor pid 0 is KEPT as gallery negatives, junk pid -1 is excluded
rules.query: pid > 0 in query/ — official query set

population_rules.provenance: Reproduces the population the recorded arm actually used (run_real_pipeline.py:488-498 → gate3_real_results_v2_corrected.json).
population_rules.validity: Valid: this is the published Market-1501 test population, taken from the directory semantics rather than from an identity-number band.
population_rules.counts_asserted_from: this run only — no standard dataset count is assumed

threshold.applied_by: identity_verifier.verify_candidate rejects when similarity < tau; this script applies accept iff score >= tau, the same rule

metric_source.per_query_pass: this script, asserted equal to the canonical aggregates before any number is reported

transreid_768_agnostic.inferential_role: descriptive only: 768-D post-BNNeck features before the fitted projection are not a deployed contract output, so no inference is drawn from this arm

gallery.norm_note: raw post-BNNeck 768-D features, deliberately not unit-norm; cosine is computed after normalisation

query.norm_note: raw post-BNNeck 768-D features, deliberately not unit-norm; cosine is computed after normalisation

retrieval.protocol: canonical Market-1501 CMC/mAP via evaluate_offline.compute_cmc_map (run_real_pipeline.compute_cmc_map, validated against torchreid 0.2.5)
retrieval.mAP_bootstrap_method: percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples of the per-query average-precision values, seed 20261019

distractor_rejection.definition: a pid-0 gallery row is rejected when its maximum cosine similarity to any query is below tau

retrieval.label: COMPUTED

threshold.applied_by: identity_verifier.verify_candidate rejects when similarity < tau; this script applies accept iff score >= tau, the same rule

at_tau.acceptance_rule: accept iff cosine_similarity >= tau (core/identity_verifier.py rejects when sim < tau)
at_tau.scope: appearance gate only; the Mahalanobis spatial gate is NOT MEASURED offline
at_tau.label: COMPUTED

per_query_decisions.denominator_rule: a query contributes to the genuine rate only if a true match survives the duplicate exclusion, and to the impostor rate only if an impostor candidate exists; -inf maxima are never counted as rejections

osnet_comparison.reason: FAILED — recorded, not repaired (charter §3B): RuntimeError: operator torchvision::nms does not exist
osnet_comparison.effect_on_comparison: no OSNet embeddings => no paired per-query outcomes for the OSNet arm => a paired test (e.g. exact McNemar) is NOT APPLICABLE on this host; the TransReID-vs-OSNet comparison must be reported NOT MEASURED here and re-run where torchreid imports
osnet_comparison.charter: §3B forbids altering OSNet to make the comparison possible; §8 forbids a paired test without paired outcomes for both arms

camera_partition_disclaimer: A camera partition on one fixed dataset. It measures whether appearance identity survives a viewpoint change between two camera groups — the property a handoff depends on — but involves no robot, no handoff event, no trajectory and no handoff label. Charter §8 explicitly forbids inferring cross-robot handoff success or false-handoff rates from Market-1501 retrieval metrics, so nothing in this section is a handoff measurement.
